title: Bounds for the iteration x ↦ a mod x
abstract: For integers 0 < b < a, let P(a,b) count the positive terms obtained by repeatedly replacing x by a mod x, starting at b. This development proves the uniform bound P(a,b) ≤ C_ε a^((41301 - 3 sqrt(82849))/137480 + ε) for every ε > 0, including the external coefficient-uniform affine-curve theorem and the effective Hilbert specialisation sieve, and its rational instance 4317/14677. It also proves the exterior-lattice exponents 471/1559 - 6 sqrt(105)/7795 and 153/520, the joint-invariant exponents (1310-sqrt(655))/4365, 2201/7480 and 128/435 and the earlier exponents 45/152, 8/27, 11/37, 23/77, and 3/10. It also proves a bound O(a^(1/4) sqrt R), where R minus one counts rises in the quotient increments, and positivity and integrality of the orbit's Hankel invariants. A separate conditional theorem gives O(a^(3/10) sqrt(log log(3a))) assuming two explicitly stated analytic estimates whose proofs are not formalised. The polar bound uses the proved orbit identity, actual common-base bound of four, degree-twelve residue labels, uniform arithmetic specialisation count, and full-pattern completion count with arbitrary common divisors. These establish the six-term local estimate without additional hypotheses. The conjectured O((log a)^2) bound remains open.
